Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task requirements by failing to correctly identify the "left word" in the decoded sentence. After reversing the text to "If you understand this sentence, write the opposite of the left word," the Planner incorrectly identified "right" as the "left word" instead of "left." This led to a logical contradiction where the opposite of "right" was calculated as "left," whereas the task actually required the opposite of "left" (which is "right"). This error stems from a failure to systematically parse the sentence structure and a premature assumption about which word constituted the target, resulting in an incorrect final answer.
